name: Pulsar ME450
summary: Pulsar ME450 is a dToF 3D LiDAR for robot navigation and obstacle avoidance. It combines MEMS pitch scanning with motorized azimuth control and supports repetitive and non-repetitive scanning patterns. Configurable field of view and rotation speed let one sensor serve different mobile-robot sensing requirements, with IP67 protection for demanding environments.

sources.title: Pulsar ME450: Multi-Pattern 3D LiDAR | Orbbec
sources.quote: Yes. The Pulsar ME450 is engineered to withstand vibration and shock and carries an IP67 dust and waterproof rating. It also provides ambient light immunity and crosstalk immunity in multi-device opposed-beam systems, which supports reliable operation where several units face one another or where strong ambient light is present.

sources.title: Pulsar ME450: Multi-Pattern 3D LiDAR | Orbbec
sources.quote: Pulsar ME450 is an innovative dToF-based 3D LiDAR that supports multiple scanning patterns. It features a high-performance optical system that combines MEMS-based pitch scanning with motorized azimuth control, and emits 200 kHz laser pulses through a precisely engineered opto-mechanical design. It offers a maximum detection range of up to 45 meters at 90% reflectivity. This enables flexible switching between scanning patterns for use in robot navigation and obstacle avoidance, as well as in general-purpose laser scanning for surveying.

sources.title: Orbbec Debuts Industry-First Multi-Pattern 3D LiDAR at Worl
sources.quote: BEIJING, August 8, 2025 — At the World Robot Conference 2025, Orbbec unveiled the Pulsar ME450, the industry’s first dToF 3D LiDAR using a combination of a MEMS mirror and a motor to offer configurable scanning patterns and adjustable vertical field of view.

sources.title: Pulsar ME450: Multi-Pattern 3D LiDAR | Orbbec
sources.quote: The Pulsar ME450 offers configurable multi-pattern scanning, allowing you to switch patterns without changing devices. It supports non-repetitive scanning and repetitive scanning at several densities, including non-dense, 2x dense, and 4x dense modes. A single unit can meet a range of 3D data acquisition requirements.

sources.quote: The Pulsar ME450 is supported across the full Orbbec SDK suite. Orbbec Viewer provides LiDAR-focused preview and configuration, sharing the same SDK and tools used with Orbbec depth cameras across platforms, which simplifies development for teams already using Orbbec products.
